body.purpose: Readable project narrative and research descriptions (Kanit 300).

label.purpose: Navigation, categories, tags, and action buttons (Kanit 500).

mono.purpose: Terminal language, benchmark readouts, and metadata (JetBrains Mono).

shadows.name: bioelectric-glow
shadows.purpose: Focused energy around active technical elements.

shadows.name: card-lift
shadows.purpose: Structural separation for a hovered major card.

shadows.name: circuit-depth
shadows.purpose: Resting depth for translucent circuit surfaces.

components.name: Contact Button
components.description: Primary luminous neural-violet pill for direct contact.
components.css: .ds-contact { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; border-radius:9999px; color:#fff; padding:12px 32px; font:500 14px Kanit,sans-serif; letter-spacing:.1em; text-transform:uppercase; background:hsl(282, 85%, 65%); box-shadow:0 0 20px hsl(282, 85%, 65% / 0.3); transition:all .2s ease; } .ds-contact:hover { transform:scale(1.05); box-shadow:0 0 25px hsl(282, 85%, 65% / 0.5); }

components.name: Outline Project Action
components.description: Quiet secondary pill that preserves project hierarchy.
components.css: .ds-outline { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; border:1px solid #D7E2EA; border-radius:9999px; color:#D7E2EA; padding:12px 32px; font:500 14px Kanit,sans-serif; letter-spacing:.1em; text-transform:uppercase; background:transparent; transition:all .2s ease; } .ds-outline:hover { color:hsl(199, 89%, 52%); border-color:hsl(199, 89%, 52%); background:hsl(199, 89%, 52% / 0.1); }

components.name: Technical Record Card
components.description: Rounded, bordered container for experience, education, and project records.
components.css: .ds-record { border:1px solid hsl(217, 33%, 15%); border-radius:24px; background:hsl(222, 14%, 8%); color:#D7E2EA; padding:32px; font-family:Kanit,sans-serif; transition:border-color .2s; } .ds-record:hover { border-color:hsl(199, 89%, 52% / 0.5); } .ds-record h3 { margin:0 0 8px; font-size:24px; font-weight:600; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-record p { margin:0; max-width:65ch; color:hsl(215, 20.2%, 70%); font-weight:300; line-height:1.625; }

components.name: Technical Chip
components.description: Non-interactive project technology label or badge.
components.css: .ds-chip { display:inline-flex; border:1px solid rgba(215, 226, 234, 0.2); border-radius:8px; color:rgba(215, 226, 234, 0.9); padding:6px 12px; font:400 12px 'JetBrains Mono',monospace; letter-spacing:0.05em; background:rgba(12, 12, 12, 0.5); transition:all .2s; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color:hsl(199, 89%, 52% / 0.6); color:hsl(199, 89%, 52%); }

narrative.overview: A cinematic systems observatory for computational biology and open-source engineering, where biological intelligence, computational machinery, and verifiable low-level engineering work feel alive. Layered atmosphere creates depth while scale, overlap, contrast, and selective elevation direct attention through inspectable evidence.
keyCharacteristics: Sparse bioelectric cyan and neural violet signals attached to state and energy
Living 3D WebGL particle observatory with reduced-motion gating
Rounded overlapping cinematic chapters with unnested readable hierarchy
Technical JetBrains Mono readouts grounded in verifiable benchmark facts

rules.name: The Signal, Not Wallpaper Rule
rules.body: Cyan and violet identify energy, state, and connection; broad neutral fields preserve their meaning.

rules.name: The Alternating Chapter Rule
rules.body: White is a deliberate narrative interruption, not a general-purpose card color within dark sections.

rules.name: The Monument and Readout Rule
rules.body: Kanit creates the monument; JetBrains Mono supplies the readout.

rules.name: The Eye-Path Rule
rules.body: Elevation must identify the current focal point or next action.

dos: Preserve the contrast between cinematic spectacle and inspectable project evidence.
Use scale, overlap, tonal chapters, and selective elevation to create a clear top-to-bottom eye path.
Keep cyan and violet attached to signals, state, biological energy, and computational connection.
Use fluid type and responsive spacing so the monumental hierarchy survives small screens.
Reserve JetBrains Mono for commands, code-adjacent metadata, dates, and technical readouts.
donts: Don't flatten the interface into a generic grid of same-sized cards.
Don't distribute glow, shadow, blur, or 3D effects evenly; atmosphere needs focal hierarchy.
Don't introduce unrelated hues or warm neutral surfaces without redefining the system deliberately.
Don't fabricate scientific imagery, metrics, endorsements, or claims to create visual drama.
Don't let particle motion, sticky stacking, or animated gradients compromise reading, focus visibility, or reduced-motion expectations.
